description: Maramec, OK — Dillon Travis, a 6th-generation Oklahoman, lifelong farmer, and rural business owner, officially announced his campaign today for the Oklahoma House of Representatives in the upcoming special election for House District 35. The Republican primary is scheduled for December 9, 2025.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Dillon Travis for State House 2026
title: Dillon Travis Announces Campaign for State House in Oklahoma’s 35th District – Dillon Travis
